description: This file defines a Java class 'CrudHttpClient', a vert.x based HTTP client designed to perform CRUD operations on HTTP APIs. It encapsulates methods for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and OPTIONS requests with customized success predicates and optional CORS header checks. The class is part of the 'org.eclipse.hono.tests' package and includes extensive HTTP request handling logic, utilizing vert.x futures and asynchronous patterns.
